note: Suite-side: the suite's token endpoint (OpenIDFederationClientTest.tokenResponse) validates the client assertion aud against config federation.entity_identifier, which in this plan is the RP's own Entity Identifier rather than the OP's, so an assertion addressed to the OP's issuer (which the suite's ValidateClientAssertionClaims otherwise accepts) fails 'aud mismatch'. The same response also omits access_token/token_type (RFC 6749 §5.1), which client.CompleteAuthorization correctly rejects. Reachable since the suite added issuer to its OP metadata (suite commit 37ae2faad, 2026-09-23).
